claim: Rev 1 disk 34A is dated 5/11/81, the earliest of four preserved Centipede releases documented in CENTI.DOC's ledger.
Rev 4's ledger entry: CENTI4/CENIR4/CENTS4 each include CENDE4 and COIN65.
Rev 4 re-cut only program EPROMs — the ledger lists no picture ROMs or sync PROM for this revision.
Rev 4 shipped no design doc — the ledger's documentation-file field is NONE.
The author's own link-command comment names the three CPU modules assembled together.
The linker map confirms the same three-module link (CENTI, CENIRQ, CENTST).
Rev 4's main CPU module CENTI4 includes the shared equates file CENDE4.
Rev 4's IRQ module CENIR4 also includes CENDE4.
Rev 4's self-test module CENTS4 also includes CENDE4.
The coin-handling module COIN65 is included from the rev-4 IRQ module.
The ROM part ledger maps the picture ROMs (136001-101/102) to their chip positions.
The ROM part ledger maps the sync PROM 136001-113, a 256x4 82S129, to chip P4.
